title: On 4-dimensional convex projective domains invariant by a lattice of $\mathrm{SL}_2 (\mathbb{R})$
summary: This paper is a sequel to the erratum by the authors to a paper by Crampon and Marquis (see arXiv:1202.5442). The main result of the Erratum was relating several notions of geometrical finiteness in round convex projective geometry and we prove here that our series of implications was sharp, by providing counterexamples to the implications that were not established. Our counterexamples are 4-dimensional convex domains $Ω$ acted on by $ρ(Γ)$ where $Γ$ is a lattice of $\mathrm{SL}_2 (\mathbb R)$ and $ρ$ is the irreducible representation of $\mathrm{SL}_2 (\mathbb R)$ of dimension $5$.
